Benfica season|2024–25]] | nextseason = [[2026–27 S.L. Benfica season|2026–27]] }} The 2025–26 [[S.L. Benfica|Sport Lisboa e Benfica]] season was the club's [[List of S.L. Benfica seasons|122nd season]] in existence and its 92nd consecutive season in the top flight of [[Football in Portugal|Portuguese football]]. Domestically, Benfica played in the [[2025–26 Primeira Liga|Primeira Liga]], and also competed in the [[2025–26 Taça da Liga|Taça da Liga]] and [[2025–26 Taça de Portugal|Taça de Portugal]]. In Europe, Benfica played in the [[2025–26 UEFA Champions League|UEFA Champions League]]. Benfica completed the season undefeated on May 16, 2026 but finished third. This marked the first time a team gone undefeated but not win the league twice.
